data: In fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), Microsoft reported revenue of $245,122 million (about $245.1 billion), gross profit, which the filing labels "gross margin," of $171,008 million, and operating income of $109,433 million. That works out to a gross margin of roughly 69.8% ($171,008 / $245,122) and an operating margin of roughly 44.6% ($109,433 / $245,122). For comparison, fiscal 2023 had a gross margin of about 68.9% on revenue of $211,915 million and an operating margin of about 41.8%, so both measures improved year over year.
